title: Stops
summary: Every stop's own life, apart from the service plans: planned, permitted, built, in service, suspended for a while, retired. Each stop on a map and in a list as it stands on a chosen day, its details and amenities, the routes that stop there in the schedule running that day, and its history — and every change recorded as a dated event: a new stop, the next stage, a suspension and the return, a move, a change of details, or a correction of an event entered wrong; a site survey filled at the stop on a phone or tablet; and the planning team's requests for work at a stop, each tracking its work order.
questions: Where is each stop, and where does it stand on a given day: planned, permitted, built, in service, suspended, or retired?
Which stops are out of service on a day, since when, until when, and why?
What is at a stop — shelter, bench, lighting, a schedule — and can a wheelchair user board there?
Which routes stop here in the schedule running that day?
What has happened to this stop, and when?
Record a change: a new stop, its next stage, a suspension and its return, a move, new details, or a correction.
What did the last site survey find at this stop, and who surveyed it?
What work has been requested at this stop, and where is its work order?
What did the agency's feed change in the stops record, and which stops in service does it not list?
session: 2026-11-13 on C-TRAN (testdata/ctran-gtfs.zip, `just qa`), every control walked at 2560x1300 and the survey and a request at 390x844: stop 1132 suspended (an end before its start refused), back early and the return corrected, moved for a while at a clicked then typed point, its details changed, surveyed with a photo, a request refused while claiming a work order it did not name, then submitted, its work order opened and read through the stub, and a change carrying it; a wrong suspension removed; a new stop QA-1 planned, permitted, built, in service, retired, shown under Retired; a taken id refused; a stop opened by a map click and by typing its name; the feed notice reviewed and its stop opened. Found and fixed: the dev proxy did not pass /attachments or /stop-requests/work-order, a suspended stop back early still read its planned end, the survey and request forms scrolled sideways on a phone, details saved with nothing changed closed silently, value-like placeholders, the map key named "this stop" with none open. Open: QAF-108, QAF-109.
